root = Path('tmp/strata-mla-logits-20261003')
results = root / 'results-values-model'

report = {}
for prefix, prompt_count in [('short128-state', 128), ('full-state', 8049)]:
    labels = [prefix + '-' + mode for mode in ('legacy', 'combined')]
    runs = [performance['runs'][label] for label in labels]
    assert runs[0]['ids'] == runs[1]['ids'] and len(runs[0]['ids']) == 129
    assert all(t['prompt_tokens'] == prompt_count and t['decode_transitions'] == 128
               for run in runs for t in run['trials'])
    ranks = []
    for rank in range(12):
        paths = [results / (label + '.state.rank%02d.bin' % rank) for label in labels]
        size = paths[0].stat().st_size
        assert size > 1000000 and size == paths[1].stat().st_size
        digest = hashlib.sha256()
        with paths[0].open('rb') as legacy, paths[1].open('rb') as candidate:
            while True:
                a, b = legacy.read(1048576), candidate.read(1048576)
                assert a == b, (prefix, rank, 'state bytes differ')
                if not a:
                    break
                digest.update(a)
        ranks.append({'rank': rank, 'bytes': size, 'sha256': digest.hexdigest()})
    report[prefix] = {'prompt_tokens': prompt_count, 'decode_transitions': 128,
                      'generated_ids': 129, 'cross_option_endpoint_state': 'BIT_EXACT',
                      'ranks': ranks}
(root / 'state-audit-values-model.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
